MEMORANDUMOFUNDERSTANDING Bradhurst Equities, L.L.C. NAMEANDADDRESSOFSELLER: c/o Artimus Construction, Inc. 316 West 118th Street, 4th Floor New York,NY 10026 NAMEANDADDRESSOF GRFO 30 Bradhurst LLC PURCHASER: 100West89thStreet #5D New York, NY 10024 DATEOFAGREEMENT: April 27, 2022 DESCRIPTIONOFPREMISES: 30-32BradhurstAvenue,NewYork,New York, also known as Tax Lot 22, Block 2044, as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto; and 28 Bradhurst Avenue, New York,New York,alsoknown as Tax Lot 4,Block 2044, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto In consideration of Ten ($10.oo) Dollars and the premises and mutual agreements herein contained, and other good and valuable consideration in hand paid by each party to the other, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby mutually acknowledged, the parties hereto, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows: Reference should be made to the Agreement of Sale,dated December 21,2021,beween Bradhurst Equities,L.L.C.("Seller") and GRFO 30 Bradhurst LLC ("Purchaser")(the "Agreement of Sale").for a full statement of all of its terms, conditions, and covenants. 1. Purchaser agrees that Seller shall retain all of the Available Floor Area Development Rights appurtenantto or generated by Lot 4 (f/k/a Lot 4 and Lot 122)if and to the extent same are available for transfer under the Zoning Resolution, any applicable Laws, and Underlying Documents (as defined below), it being understood and agreed that Purchaser is making no representations with respect to the availability and/or amount thereof. Seller agrees that Purchaser shall retain all of the Utilized Development Rights (as defined below) and,other than the Available Floor Area Development Rights, all ownership rights with respect to Lot 4, including, without limitation, the rights to access, utilize and enjoy same. HFOT1/5954.0043/3237142.5

2.1 In the event that any Agency determines that Lot 4 and/or Lot 22 are a part of a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot"), the provisions above will still be enforceable, provided that Purchaser shall retain all Floor Area Development Rights that are utilized or incorporated into the existing building on Lot 22 (the “Utilized Development Rights"). Seller shall retain the Available Floor Area Development Rights as it applies to the Lot 4. Seller shall cause the preparation of a Development Rights Survey (as defined below), prepared by a licensed architect having experience in such matters, which shall be subject to the review and reasonable approval of Purchaser and/or Purchaser's architect. The Development Rights Survey shall set forth: (i) whether Lot 22 and Lot 4 are a Combined event there is a Combined Zoning Lot, and (ii) the amount of Available Floor Area Development Rights. In the event there shall be a disagreement between the parties regarding the accuracy of the proposed Development Rights Survey, the parties shall cooperate to resolve any issues, or, if such cooperation shall be unsuccessful, the parties shall designate an independent, third architect having experience in such matters, to resolve any disagreements of the parties. 3. Purchaser acknowledges that Seller intends totransfer the Available Floor Area Development Rights at some time in the future, to a parcel of land located within Block 2044 (a. "Transferee Parcel"; the owner of such parcel, a “Transferee"). In connection with same, and subject to the terms and provisions herein, Purchaser shall reasonably cooperate, at Seller's cost and expense, with any applications or submissions or agreements or zoning exhibits (the “Zoning Documents") to any Agency or third parties regarding the individual zoning lots or the Combined Zoning Lot, which shall include and not be limited to the execution, acknowledgement, delivery, filing and recording of any ministerial applications, statements, certifications, documents or instruments for any permits and certificates, or any modifications or amendments thereof, and the processing thereof by any Agency, as the Seller may reasonably request in connection therewith necessary to effectuate Seller's merger of Lot 4 or the Combined Zoning Lot with another zoning lot, provided that the Zoning Documents and any related applications, submissions, documents and instruments: (i) shall not adversely affect Lot 22,the building located on Lot 22, Lot 4 and Purchaser's rights with respect thereto (including the use and enjoyment thereof); (ii) shall be consistent with applicable Laws and the Underlying Documents; and (iii) shall not be inconsistent with the terms described herein. In each instance that Seller, consistent with the foregoing, desires that the Purchaser execute Zoning Documents, the Seller shall make a written request to the Purchaser, which request shall be accompanied by the following documents, for Purchaser's review and reasonable approval:
